notes: Shortcuts. A panel can now show a card of shortcuts that open a program, a folder, or a web address - sized for a fingertip, so it works on a touchscreen as well as with a mouse.

Add them once in Control Panel, Options, Shortcuts. Type a name and a target, or use Choose file to pick a program or folder. Each panel then has its own Show shortcuts switch in Panel Settings, the same way weather works - one list, and…
A shortcut that cannot be opened says so on the button itself for a moment rather than doing nothing. Usually that means the program or folder has moved.

Shortcuts that open a program, a folder or a link are supported. Running an arbitrary command is deliberately not, because the shortcut list is an ordinary settings file and anything able to edit it could otherwise make a tap run code.
